answer: Each interaction’s contribution decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so reputation requires sustained honest service rather than a one-time accumulation. In the EigenTrust-style matrix, a freshly spawned identity has negligible incoming trust and near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot create independent endorsements from a sybil cluster, leaving it unable to pass consensus thresholds. Labels such as raven, cedar, or ivory do not alter the trust edges.
